title: Amplification of Three DNA Regions from Nephila clavipes
author: Luiz Filipe Bartoleti
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.knwcvfe
materials: PCR Reaction: 1μL of template DNA, 1U of Taq DNA Polymerase (Thermo-Fisher), 2.5μL of 10X KCl Buffer (Thermo-Fisher), 2.8μL of 25mM MgCl2 (Thermo-Fisher), 1μL of 10mM dNTP mix (GE Healthcare), 0.5μL of each forward and reverse primer 10μM, and ddH2O to the volume of 25μL.

PCR Reaction: 1μL of template DNA, 1U of Taq DNA Polymerase (Thermo-Fisher), 2.5μL of 10X KCl Buffer (Thermo-Fisher), 2.3μL of 25mM MgCl2 (Thermo-Fisher), 0.5μL of 10mM dNTP mix (GE Healthcare), 0.5μL of each forward and reverse primer 10μM, and ddH2O to the volume of 25μL.

PCR Reaction: 1μL of template DNA, 1U of Taq DNA Polymerase (Thermo-Fisher), 2.5μL of 10X KCl Buffer (Thermo-Fisher), 3.5μL of 25mM MgCl2 (Thermo-Fisher), 0.5μL of 10mM dNTP mix (GE Healthcare), 0.4μL of each forward and reverse primer 10μM, and ddH2O to the volume of 25μL.

steps.title: Amplify first DNA region
steps.instruction: Run PCR cycling for the first DNA region using the following parameters:

substeps.instruction: 30 cycles of: denaturation at 94ºC for 45s, annealing at 51ºC for 45s, and extension at 72ºC for 2 min

steps.title: Amplify Histone 3 (H3a) nuclear gene
steps.instruction: Run PCR cycling for the H3a nuclear gene using the following parameters:

substeps.instruction: 30 cycles of: denaturation at 94ºC for 45s, annealing at 46ºC for 1 min, and extension at 72ºC for 1 min

steps.title: Amplify third DNA region
steps.instruction: Run PCR cycling for the third DNA region using the following parameters:

substeps.instruction: 30 cycles of: denaturation at 95ºC for 45s, annealing at 61ºC for 45s, and extension at 72ºC for 2 min
